### Summary

I found nothing to flag in this part. The new `screenshotOverlayStateRequest` channel carries no payload. The main-process handler ignores the call outside a pick and answers only a sender that is one of its own live overlay windows, so the Electron boundary is not widened. The renderer calls `requestState()` after `onState` is attached, and the renderer test checks that order. The main-process tests cover both resending the state during a pick and doing nothing outside one. I did not run the tests.
